about_the_game:
☆Game Character☆

Name: Yoko

Gender: Female

Age: 21

Height: 163cm

[Personality Setting]

Bossy is her protective colour, she always looks fierce to the outside world and never accepts anyone's kindness. But when she's at work, she puts on a cute, affectionate sexy face, and her personality is more on the tsundere side!

Name: Yukina

Gender: Female

Age: 23

Height: 168cm

[Personality Setting]

She always has an older sisterly demeanour, and because she has been through thick and thin herself, she wants to shelter others from the wind and rain as well. But even so, she is still a girl who lacks love, and will do everything she can for others, but doesn't want to be given anything by others, so her personality is more like that of a gentle older sister.

☆[Game Plot]☆

This is a visual novel game where the player takes on the role of the protagonist caught in a loop to rescue the heroine.

A small town was once filled with miracles created by wishes.

The child who had fallen into a serious illness and had no cure has recovered. People who were once at a low point in their lives, but who have been stranded, have been revived by chance and are now looking towards hope. A dead lover is brought back to life...

Miracles that go against the grain of the world are repeated time and time again in this small town. People are convinced of the existence of the so-called ‘Wish’.

But the price for this is seldom mentioned.

☆[Game Feature]

☆ The game contains 42 CGs (15 High Quality Dynamic CGs + 27 Chibi CGs)

☆ The heroine is dubbed in Japanese

☆ Character dressing 

☆ Character interaction

short_description: This is a visual novel game where players play a protagonist trapped in a time loop and break the loop to save the heroine. The game contains suspense, love, and funny storylines. Players need to make the right choices, and there are multiple endings to explore in the game.
